title: Titanstring Bow
summary: A +1 longbow that adds Strength to damage on top of Dexterity.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial two-handed longbow, 60 ft range. +1 to attacks. Hit for 1d8 + 1 Piercing plus Dexterity, with a separate Titan Weapon bonus. Dippable.
fields.Titan Weapon: Add your Strength modifier to damage, minimum +1. It is absent from the displayed attack tooltip. Outside Honour Mode the bonus can also apply to separate riders such as special arrows or a Sneak Attack reaction. In Honour Mode it can still apply to special arrows. Seeking Arrow and Piercing Arrow Arcane Shots do not qualify.
fields.Brace (Ranged): Spend 20 ft movement once per Short Rest with proficiency. Roll ranged damage twice and use the higher result for the rest of the turn. Breaks Hiding and Invisibility.
fields.Hamstring Shot: Action, once per Short Rest with proficiency. Deal ranged weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents half movement speed for 2 turns.
fields.Pushing Attack: Action once per Short Rest. On a hit, deal weapon damage. A separate Strength save against weapon-action DC prevents the 15 ft push shown in the description. Does not require Longbow proficiency or spend a Superiority Die.
fields.Acquisition: Brem’s special stock after Find the Missing Shipment, or Lann Tarv if that stock was never unlocked.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
